product.title: LH Stash
product.body:
LH Stash is a high-impact display type family designed for logos, storefront lettering and bold environmental graphics. Built for shop signs, restaurant identities and event branding, it takes inspiration from hand-painted lettering, marker calligraphy and vernacular street typography — where speed, gesture and clarity collide. Despite its expressive appearance, Stash is built as a multiplex system. All styles share the same spacing, allowing designers to switch between variations without breaking layout consistency. The result is a family that feels energetic and immediate, while remaining structurally stable.

The family is organized into three subfamilies:

• Stash Stroke focuses on the drawn line itself through four outline styles — Stroke 1 to Stroke 4 — ranging from clean single strokes to dense layered builds where repetition creates texture and presence.

• Stash Plain translates the same gesture into solid forms through four weights. These styles are direct, bold and highly legible, designed for maximum impact in signage, storefronts and logo systems. A variable font version allows smooth control across the range.

• Stash Mix combines filled shapes and isolated strokes across 12 hybrid styles, creating more expressive, sometimes unexpected compositions that feel handmade and slightly improvised.

Across its 20 styles, Stash is built for visibility and character. It is designed for branding systems that need to stand out instantly, from boutique identities and restaurant signage to food festivals and cultural events, where typography must work as both logo and atmosphere.

brand.title: Léon Hugues
brand.body:
Based in Paris, Léon is a British-French designer who specializes in drawing custom letters, wordmarks, and full typefaces for global brands. Beyond digital production and refinement, he brings a human touch to his work through event calligraphy and bespoke lettering. His dual heritage and versatile skillset allow him to navigate the worlds of high-end branding and traditional craft with ease.

Through LH Fontsby Léon Hugues leads an exploratory type practice and focuses on script typefaces.
Each design emerges from experimentation with gesture, rhythm, and movement.
Moving away from polished solutions and fixed conventions, LH Fonts explores irregularity, personality, and the nuances of handwritten-inspired forms in a digital and print world.
